in_sanskrit.name: गोविन्द
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गो (go) - cow विन्द (vinda) - one who is found or comes So, Gowtham means 'One who is found or comes among cows'

in_hindi.name: गोविंद
in_hindi.meaning: गो (go) - cow विंद (vinda) - one who is found or comes So, Gowtham means 'One who is found or comes among cows'

in_tamil.name: கோவிடம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: கோ (ko) - cow விடம் (vitam) - place So, Gowtham means 'Place of cows'

in_telugu.name: గౌదమ
in_telugu.meaning: గౌద (goudam) - cow మ (ma) - son So, Gowtham means 'Son of a cow'

in_marathi.name: Gowtham
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cave, Mountain Fort
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gowtham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gowtham is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Guh’ which means cave and ‘Tham’ which means mountain fort. This name is associated with Lord Vishnu and is considered auspicious in Hindu tradition.
